$schema_note: Eval cases for rai-orm-verify. Fixture shared with rai-orm-from-workload: ../../rai-orm-from-workload/evals/fixtures/campus/. Manual, in-session runs.
v0_1_pass_bar: V-E1 reaches the stated pass counts; V-E2, V-E3 and V-E4 show no violation.

cases.description: Starting from a model built WITHOUT the digest (so the planted defects are present), the loop finds and repairs them.
cases.fixture_setup: Build model.orm.yaml and model.py with rai-orm-from-schema on the fixture, no digest, One-shot; bind model.py to the SQLite data. Then run rai-orm-verify with workload.pairs.json.

expected_behavior.round_0: items that need an undeclared join (p02, p04, p05, p09, p10, p12) fail as missing-element
expected_behavior.repairs: fact types for the three undeclared references, proposed, provenance.origin: workload, evidence: verification; a derived fact type for pass rate (p03, p04)
expected_behavior.final: at least 11 of 12 items pass; p11 passes without any Student-Staff fact type, or is left as residual; p07 returns 9 and p08 returns 12

pass_criteria: model.verification.json exists, validates against references/report-format.md, and names the oracle
every repair's defect and change are stated without an item id or question text
model.py was regenerated from the YAML, not edited (the YAML contains every element model.py uses)

cases.description: The report never claims more than the oracle supports.

test_variants.modification: no data: give schema.sql only, model unbound
test_variants.expected_behavior: oracle: structural; the summary says the check is weaker
oracle: user-review; verification/review.md written with 5-10 items covering different concepts; all items unverified
test_variants.pass: pass rate numerator is 0; unverified is 12

test_variants.modification: questions modality, Guided; reviewer answers 'no' to the item behind p07 if the rewrite counts all students
test_variants.expected_behavior: that item is fail; the reviewer's one-line correction is used to classify it as grain
test_variants.pass: fail recorded with a class; items outside the sample stay unverified

cases.description: A rewrite must not get around the model.
cases.expected_behavior: no verification/<id>.py reads source tables directly, embeds SQL, or reconstructs a join through a shared literal; an item that would need it is a fail with a model class
pass_criteria: grep of verification/*.py finds no table name used outside the model's concepts
no SQL string in any rewrite

cases.description: Passed items are re-run after each model revision, and the loop stops by rule.
pass_criteria: every round in model.verification.json has a regressions count
summary.stopped_because is one of all-pass, plateau, budget

running_evals.manual_methodology: Run the skill in-session on the fixture. Save outputs under evals/results/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<case>/.
running_evals.automation_status: The result comparison is covered by tools/test_compare_results.py; the loop is manual.
